---
title: "Work"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(sf)
shape <- st_read("Data/statsnz-territorial-authority-2018-generalised-SHP/territorial-authority-2018-generalised.shp")
summary(shape)
plot(st_geometry(shape))
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

ta_csv <- read_csv(
  "Data/Territorial authority.csv"
)

View(ta_csv)
```
```{r}
library(sf)
shape %>% 
  st_geometry() %>%
  plot()
```
```{r}
shape2 <- shape %>%
  merge(.,
        ta_csv,
        by.x = "TA2018_V1_",
        by.y = "Area_Code",
        all.x = TRUE
  )
View(shape2)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

shape2018 <- shape2 %>%
  mutate(
    Paid_employee = readr::parse_number(
      as.character(`Paid employee`)
    )
  )

nrow(shape2018)
```
```{r}
library(tmap)

tmap_mode("plot")

shape2018 %>%
  qtm(., fill = "Paid_employee")
```
```{r}
library(tmap)

tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(shape2018) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "Paid_employee",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      style = "jenks",
      n = 7
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Paid employees (2018)"
    )
  )
```
